semantics.ChangeFrameWidthRate: minimum paint-radius multiplier caused by elapsed time
semantics.ChangeWidthStartFrame: frame at which the paint-radius reduction begins
semantics.ChangeWidthEndFrame: frame by which the paint-radius reduction has completed

transition: Linear between ChangeWidthStartFrame and ChangeWidthEndFrame: no reduction at or before the start frame, ChangeFrameWidthRate exactly at the end frame. Splatoon 3 publishes no sub-frame curve for these fields, so no other curve is claimed.
explicitUnknowns: sub-frame interpolation rounding inside the transition window is unverified
whether the reduction is sampled per frame or continuously by the original integrator is unverified
INKWAVE world-unit calibration is not involved: this dimension is a frame-based multiplier only
dimensionsNotCovered: per-group near/far paint width (WidthHalfNear / WidthHalfFar / DistanceFar) — issue #411
late-airtime damage falloff (DamageRejectStartFrame / DamageRejectEndFrame / DamageRejectRate) — issues #124 / #128
depletion paint scaling (DepletionDepthWidthRate), splash/near splash paint widths and wall-drop paint radii
visual draw size (DrawSizeParam) and per-group bullet counts
verification: All listed values were re-read from the pinned commit before implementation; no value was inferred from gameplay footage or from an INKWAVE world-unit conversion.
